tasks.short: Explain the monthly financial results for Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo to management.

today.trigger: A monthly management reporting deadline or a request for an updated financial position; this workflow is inferred from the supplied systems.
steps: Pull the AFAS trial balance and check the refresh date of the Power BI extract.
Compare actual results with budget, forecast and the previous period by site.
Ask the Controller and site managers about material differences.
Write commentary and assemble the management report.
Review the figures and discuss the report with management.
drudgery: Copying the same figures between spreadsheets and reporting slides.
Rewriting recurring variance commentary.
Chasing explanations that arrive in different formats.
today.time_sinks: Reconciling report versions and waiting for explanations, especially when the nightly extract excludes recent close entries.

lenses.faster: Generate the tables and first commentary from one reconciled reporting snapshot. Manual copying, chart updates and routine wording disappear.
lenses.autonomous: A successful refresh starts the report build and sends only unexplained material variances to their owners. Publication waits for accountant approval.
lenses.ambitious: Give each site a weekly view of margin, working capital and forecast risks, with consistent definitions and evidence behind each explanation.
lenses.joy: Remove spreadsheet assembly and repeated chasing. Spend more time explaining what changed and helping managers act.
lenses.options: Prepare separate views for the Finance Director, site managers and the Controller, using the same numbers and clearly labelled assumptions.
lenses.altitude: Own the reporting definitions, explanation standards and exception thresholds instead of assembling each report.
reach: Controller: routine management reporting preparation
FP&A Analyst: initial variance analysis and forecast risk identification

tasks.human_edge: Challenge explanations, distinguish timing effects from operational problems, and discuss uncomfortable results with managers.
tasks.pattern_why: Deterministic calculations produce the numbers; an llm_step drafts commentary from approved evidence. Management reporting requires a person to approve explanations and publication.

in_practice.trigger: The reporting snapshot passes reconciliation and freshness checks.
steps: Freeze a dated AFAS extract and reconcile report totals to the trial balance.
Calculate site and account variances using approved mappings and thresholds.
Draft commentary with links to figures and existing manager explanations; flag missing causes.
Collect outstanding explanations through a controlled Teams workflow.
Present the report and unresolved issues for approval, then publish the approved version.
in_practice.human_gate: The accountant approves material explanations and the report; the Finance Director retains responsibility for management decisions.
systems: AFAS Profit read-only export or approved connector
data_needed: Trial balance, journal detail and site mappings
Approved budget and forecast versions
Comparable prior periods
Manager explanations and reporting thresholds
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint reporting register containing snapshot identifiers, reconciliations, source links, edits and approval timestamps.

evidence.claim: Power BI supports scheduled data refresh and reusable reports.
A model can draft variance commentary from supplied figures and explanations, subject to factual review.
The proposed workflow could save 60% of accountant effort and deliver reports 1.8 times faster; these are untested estimates.

risks: A nightly extract can omit late journals and produce a convincing but outdated report.
Generated commentary may invent causes or treat correlation as explanation.
Different site mappings can make comparisons misleading.
Commercial and employee cost information requires restricted access; use aggregate payroll data.
research_questions: How much of the current 59.4 hours is report assembly, explanation chasing and management discussion?
Can the reporting snapshot be reconciled to AFAS after all relevant close journals?
Are site mappings, forecast versions and materiality thresholds consistent?
Will a pilot preserve factual accuracy while reducing both preparation time and approval delays?

tasks.short: Calculate our taxes and prepare checked returns and payment instructions.

today.trigger: A tax filing deadline or a transaction requiring tax treatment; the exact division with payroll and external advisers needs confirmation.
steps: Collect AFAS tax balances, transaction details and prior returns.
Reconcile VAT accounts and investigate unusual or cross-border transactions.
Calculate the return and document adjustments using current Dutch tax rules.
Obtain review of uncertain treatments and prepare the filing.
Arrange authorised submission and payment, then retain receipts and reconciliations.
systems: Applicable tax filing portal or software
drudgery: Rebuilding tax reconciliations each period.
Rechecking recurring transaction classifications.
Copying approved figures into filing and payment workflows.
today.time_sinks: Resolving missing invoice evidence, cross-border VAT treatment and differences between ledger balances and return figures.

lenses.faster: Use versioned tax rules and reconciliations to prepare routine calculations. AI extracts relevant facts from supporting documents and highlights exceptions.
lenses.autonomous: The tax calendar triggers a reconciled draft return and an exception list. Submission and payment remain separately authorised.
lenses.ambitious: Check tax coding throughout the month so missing evidence and unusual VAT treatments are resolved before filing week.
lenses.joy: Remove repeated reconciliations and form transcription. Keep the work of resolving tax questions and improving source data.
lenses.options: For genuinely uncertain treatments, show the evidence, alternative calculations and questions for the tax adviser; do not let a model select the legal position.
lenses.altitude: Maintain a tested tax calculation and evidence process, with clear rules for adviser escalation.
reach: Bookkeeper: tax coding quality checks
Controller: tax balance reconciliations and compliance calendar

tasks.human_edge: Judge uncertain tax positions, challenge insufficient evidence and accept responsibility for the reviewed return.
tasks.pattern_why: Deterministic software should calculate tax from approved rules. Document extraction can use an llm_step, while filing preparation, exceptions and approval require a controlled workflow.

in_practice.trigger: A filing period reaches its preparation date and the relevant ledger data is available.
steps: Load a dated ledger snapshot, applicable rule versions and filing obligations.
Reconcile tax control accounts and run deterministic return calculations.
Extract supporting facts from invoices and flag missing evidence or unusual transactions.
Build a draft return, adjustment schedule and proposed payment instruction.
Route the package to authorised reviewers and retain filing and payment acknowledgements.
in_practice.human_gate: An authorised tax reviewer approves the return and any uncertain treatment before submission; Rabobank payment approval remains with designated signatories. Payroll taxes stay with the Payroll Specialist unless explicitly reassigned.
systems: AFAS Profit read-only export or approved connector
data_needed: Tax-coded transaction detail and tax account balances
Invoice evidence and relevant cross-border transaction facts
Prior returns, adjustments and filing acknowledgements
Current tax rules, filing calendar and reviewer authority
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint tax file with calculation versions, source evidence, reviewer decisions, submission receipts and payment references.

evidence.claim: Structured ledger data can support repeatable tax calculations and reconciliation checks under explicitly maintained rules.
Dutch VAT treatment can depend on transaction facts that a ledger tax code alone does not establish.
The proposed workflow could save 55% of accountant effort and complete the task 1.6 times faster; these are untested estimates.

risks: Outdated rules or incomplete transaction facts can produce incorrect returns.
Cross-border transport, reverse charges and input VAT eligibility may need specialist review.
Automation must not combine preparation, filing authority and payment approval in one unrestricted identity.
Assuming the accountant owns payroll tax would duplicate or weaken the Payroll Specialist's responsibilities.
research_questions: Which taxes and filings does this accountant actually own, and which belong to payroll or an external adviser?
What filing functionality, interfaces and approvals are available in the current AFAS setup?
Which transaction types generate most tax adjustments or adviser questions?
Can a pilot reproduce accepted historical returns and explain every difference?

tasks.short: Review balance sheet accounts and investigate unusual movements in assets, liabilities, income and costs.

today.trigger: A month close review, a material account movement or a query from the Controller.
steps: Export balances and transaction detail from AFAS.
Gather bank statements, asset schedules and supporting reconciliations.
Compare balances with supporting records and prior periods.
Investigate unmatched items, unusual movements and old balances.
Document conclusions and propose any correcting journals for approval.
drudgery: Matching the same recurring balances every month.
Recreating account reconciliation workbooks.
Searching folders for evidence behind old reconciling items.
today.time_sinks: Tracing unmatched entries and carrying unresolved items between spreadsheet versions.

lenses.faster: Match routine entries and calculate movements automatically. Start the review with unresolved items and their supporting evidence.
lenses.autonomous: Run approved reconciliation rules after each extract and mark exact, fully supported matches as passed. Send exceptions to the accountant without posting corrections.
lenses.ambitious: Maintain reconciliations throughout the month and track whether old items are actually cleared, reducing surprises during close.
lenses.joy: Remove repeated matching and workbook maintenance. Keep investigation, judgement and conversations that resolve the underlying cause.
lenses.options: Rank exceptions by value, age, recurrence and possible close impact, giving the accountant several useful review orders.
lenses.altitude: Own reconciliation coverage, rule quality and unresolved item ageing across the ledger.
reach: Bookkeeper: recurring reconciliation checks
Controller: balance sheet substantiation tracking

tasks.human_edge: Assess recoverability, impairment, completeness and economic substance when records agree but the balance may still be wrong.
tasks.pattern_why: Matching, roll-forwards, ageing and threshold checks are reproducible calculations. AI can help build the rules, but routine execution does not need a model.

in_practice.trigger: A complete AFAS extract and its required supporting schedules arrive.
steps: Validate extract completeness, account mappings and control totals.
Run approved bank, asset and balance reconciliation rules.
Attach source references to exact matches and retain unresolved differences.
Assign exceptions by materiality, age and account owner.
Record the accountant's conclusions and route proposed journals through existing approval.
in_practice.human_gate: Only approved exact-match rules can pass automatically. The accountant reviews exceptions and judgemental balances; correcting journals require existing authorisation.
systems: AFAS Profit read-only export or approved connector
data_needed: Opening balances, closing balances and full transaction detail
Bank statements and asset schedules
Account ownership and matching rules
Materiality thresholds and prior unresolved items
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted reconciliation register recording rule versions, matched transaction identifiers, differences, evidence and resolutions.

evidence.claim: Exact matching, ageing and account roll-forwards can be implemented as deterministic checks on structured records.
Power BI can display reconciliation status and unresolved item ageing when supplied with those datasets.
The proposed workflow could save 65% of accountant effort and complete reviews 2.2 times faster; these are untested estimates.

risks: Loose matching tolerances can conceal real differences.
A balanced reconciliation does not establish that all liabilities were recorded.
Missing or duplicated extracts can create false exceptions or false assurance.
Netting balances can conceal material gross exposures.
research_questions: Which accounts consume most review time, and what proportion of items are exact or recurring matches?
Are stable transaction identifiers available across AFAS, bank files and supporting schedules?
Can the rules detect known historical errors without excessive false alarms?
Which balances require documented human judgement every period regardless of matching results?

tasks.short: Write evidence-backed reports on financial control findings and agreed corrective actions.

today.trigger: An internal review or an external audit identifies findings that require a management report.
steps: Collect review notes, test results and supporting documents.
Clarify the observed issue and its financial or control impact.
Draft each finding with evidence, cause and recommended action.
Confirm factual accuracy and action ownership with relevant managers.
Issue the reviewed report and track agreed responses.
drudgery: Turning scattered notes into consistent report sections.
Reformatting evidence references and action tables.
Reconciling multiple versions of management responses.
today.time_sinks: Finding the evidence behind a statement and agreeing wording, severity and action ownership.

lenses.faster: Draft findings from a structured evidence register and standard report template. Reformatting, reference assembly and repeated summaries disappear.
lenses.autonomous: A completed review file triggers a draft report and missing-evidence checklist. Findings cannot be issued until reviewed.
lenses.ambitious: Build a history of recurring findings across all three sites and check whether corrective actions prevent recurrence.
lenses.joy: Remove report formatting and version comparison. Keep investigation, fair judgement and productive discussion with action owners.
lenses.options: Generate an executive summary, detailed finding and action-owner checklist from the same approved evidence.
lenses.altitude: Own the quality and consistency of findings and the effectiveness of remediation, rather than writing every paragraph.
reach: Controller: control issue register maintenance
Finance Director: remediation progress reporting

tasks.human_edge: Choose fair severity, distinguish evidence from suspicion, and negotiate workable corrective actions without weakening the finding.
tasks.pattern_why: An llm_step can structure and draft findings from evidence. Several review and response steps are needed before a report becomes an official record.

in_practice.trigger: A reviewer marks an evidence package ready for report drafting.
steps: Check that each proposed finding has a documented criterion, observation and evidence reference.
Draft the finding, impact and proposed action using only supplied evidence.
Flag unsupported causes, missing facts and conflicting records.
Collect factual corrections and proposed action owners in a versioned register.
Obtain approval and issue a locked report with its action tracker.
in_practice.human_gate: The accountant validates evidence and wording; the designated review owner approves severity and issue. An external auditor retains responsibility for its own findings and audit opinion.
data_needed: Review scope, criteria and test results
Evidence identifiers and permitted supporting documents
Finding severity guidance
Management responses, action owners and deadlines
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint findings register with evidence links, draft changes, factual challenges, approvals and issued versions.

evidence.claim: Language models can turn supplied notes into structured draft reports, but source references and conclusions need checking.
SharePoint supports document version history and access-controlled document storage.
The proposed workflow could save 55% of accountant effort and complete reports 1.8 times faster; these are untested estimates.

risks: A fluent draft may overstate evidence, impact or causation.
Unverified source references can make a weak finding appear substantiated.
Sensitive allegations or personal information may reach inappropriate readers.
Report production must not be confused with independently performing an audit.
research_questions: Does this task concern internal control reports, responses to external auditors, or both?
Are test results and evidence references structured enough to support reliable drafting?
How much time is spent drafting compared with investigating and agreeing findings?
Can reviewers identify every unsupported statement in a pilot before issue?

tasks.short: Assess the tax effects of our assets, financing and valuations with the tax adviser.

today.trigger: A year-end tax calculation, asset transaction or financing change requires assessment; confirm which parts of this broad O*NET task apply.
steps: Collect asset records, financing agreements and prior fiscal schedules.
Identify relevant differences between accounting values and tax values.
Calculate depreciation, interest and valuation effects under applicable rules.
Discuss uncertain assumptions or treatments with the tax adviser.
Document the agreed position and pass approved figures into the tax provision or return process.
drudgery: Rebuilding fiscal asset roll-forwards.
Transcribing financing terms into calculation sheets.
Tracing prior-year assumptions and adviser decisions.
today.time_sinks: Finding complete agreements and determining which accounting and fiscal differences actually apply to the company.

lenses.faster: Extract contract terms into a checked schedule and run approved valuation and tax formulas. Routine roll-forwards and repeated sensitivity calculations disappear.
lenses.autonomous: An approved asset or financing change triggers an updated draft fiscal schedule. New treatments and assumptions remain subject to review.
lenses.ambitious: Assess material tax and cash consequences before major fleet, warehouse equipment or financing decisions are signed.
lenses.joy: Remove contract transcription and repeated formula maintenance. Keep interpretation and discussions about the commercial consequences.
lenses.options: Compare purchase, lease and financing scenarios using explicit assumptions, showing accounting profit, taxable profit and cash timing separately.
lenses.altitude: Own the fiscal assumptions, calculation controls and adviser escalation process.
reach: FP&A Analyst: tax sensitivities in investment scenarios
Controller: fiscal asset schedules and tax provision support

tasks.human_edge: Determine whether a rule applies to the actual arrangement and judge assumptions whose tax effect depends on legal or commercial substance.
tasks.pattern_why: Deterministic software handles approved formulas and scenarios; an llm_step extracts agreement terms. Selecting tax treatments and accepting assumptions require expert approval.

in_practice.trigger: An approved transaction changes a relevant asset, financing arrangement or fiscal assumption.
steps: Collect the executed agreement, asset record and previous fiscal schedule.
Extract terms with document references and flag ambiguities for review.
Apply approved fiscal rules and calculate book-to-tax differences.
Produce a base case and requested sensitivities with an assumption register.
Obtain accountant or adviser approval before sending figures to the tax preparation workflow.
in_practice.human_gate: The accountant validates extracted terms and calculations; a qualified tax adviser reviews novel or material uncertain treatments. No model independently selects a tax position.
systems: AFAS Profit read-only asset and ledger exports
Versioned calculation engine or controlled Excel model
data_needed: Asset purchase values, dates, useful lives and fiscal opening values
Executed loan and lease agreements
Approved tax rules and prior adviser positions
Scenario assumptions and materiality thresholds
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted fiscal calculation file linking contract clauses, extracted terms, formula versions, assumptions and approvals.

evidence.claim: Asset roll-forwards, interest schedules and valuation sensitivities can be calculated deterministically once rules and inputs are approved.
The references to securities and depletable assets in the O*NET statement may not describe this logistics company's actual work.
The proposed workflow could save 45% of accountant effort and complete assessments 1.5 times faster; these are untested estimates.

risks: Automating an O*NET activity that is absent locally would create work without value.
Commercial and fiscal depreciation or lease treatment may differ.
Incorrect contract extraction can affect several years of calculations.
This assessment and tax return preparation can overlap; savings must not be counted twice.
research_questions: Which asset, financing and valuation assessments occur locally, and are any securities or depletable assets relevant?
Who owns the fiscal schedules and tax provision: the accountant, Controller or external adviser?
Are the required contracts, fiscal opening values and prior decisions complete?
Can the proposed calculations reproduce adviser-approved historical schedules?

tasks.short: Check whether our finance systems and interfaces produce reliable records and recommend better controls.

today.trigger: A system change, reconciliation failure, audit finding or periodic control review.
steps: Map the relevant financial process and its systems.
Collect access roles, configuration records, interface logs and sample transactions.
Test completeness, accuracy, authorisation and segregation of duties.
Discuss exceptions and actual working practices with process owners.
Recommend controls and agree ownership and verification of fixes.
drudgery: Collecting repeated access and configuration exports.
Comparing interface totals manually.
Rewriting process descriptions and control matrices.
today.time_sinks: Obtaining usable logs and understanding where manual workarounds bypass the documented process.

lenses.faster: Automate access comparisons, interface reconciliations and evidence collection. Use AI to draft process maps and test scripts for the accountant to challenge.
lenses.autonomous: Approved checks can monitor failed extracts, unexplained control-total changes and defined role conflicts, with exceptions routed to owners.
lenses.ambitious: Check critical financial interfaces continuously, including agency invoices and the AFAS-to-Power BI flow, instead of discovering failures during close.
lenses.joy: Remove export collection and repetitive comparisons. Keep investigation, control design and practical discussions with system owners.
lenses.options: Compare preventive and detective controls by effort, coverage and residual risk before recommending a change.
lenses.altitude: Become the finance owner of control coverage and evidence quality across systems.
reach: Controller: finance control framework maintenance
People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: finance-side validation of HR and payroll interfaces
Bookkeeper: payment and supplier control checks

tasks.human_edge: Understand how people actually work, recognise collusion and workarounds, and choose controls that protect the business without obstructing it.
tasks.pattern_why: Tools can collect evidence and run defined tests, but evaluating control design and recommending acceptable trade-offs remain led by the accountant.

in_practice.trigger: A scheduled review or an approved system or interface change.
steps: Collect authorised read-only exports and record their scope and timestamps.
Run defined access, interface completeness and approval-path tests.
Draft a control matrix showing evidence, gaps and possible improvements.
Have the accountant interview owners and test whether the proposed explanation holds.
Submit recommendations for approval and retest implemented changes.
in_practice.human_gate: The accountant approves conclusions; the relevant system owner authorises configuration changes, and the Controller or Finance Director accepts residual financial risk.
data_needed: Current role assignments and approved role-conflict rules
Interface specifications, logs and control totals
Approval limits and process ownership
Historical incidents, exceptions and remediation evidence
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint control register with test versions, evidence timestamps, findings, risk acceptance and retest results.

evidence.claim: Role-conflict checks and interface control-total comparisons can run as deterministic tests when usable exports and approved rules exist.
Power BI exposes refresh history that can support monitoring of reporting data freshness.
The proposed workflow could save 35% of accountant effort and complete reviews 1.3 times faster; these are untested estimates.

risks: Incomplete access exports can hide inherited permissions and create false assurance.
Monitoring with an overprivileged service identity can weaken segregation of duties.
Automated tests can miss collusion and workarounds outside the recorded workflow.
Controls involving employee monitoring require an AVG assessment and assessment of applicable OR consent rights before implementation.
research_questions: Which systems provide complete role, approval and interface logs under current licences?
Which historical control failures would the proposed tests have detected?
Who owns each interface, approves rule changes and accepts unresolved risks?
Can controls operate with read-only access and without collecting unnecessary employee data?

tasks.short: Prepare and check our annual accounts and supporting financial statements.

today.trigger: A year-end reporting timetable, an interim statement request or an external audit evidence request.
steps: Gather the trial balance, reconciliations and supporting schedules.
Map ledger accounts into the applicable financial statement structure.
Prepare statements, cash flow information and required disclosures.
Check arithmetic, consistency, comparatives and supporting evidence.
Resolve review points with the Controller and external accountant or auditor.
Prepare the approved reporting package for directors and any required filing.
drudgery: Rekeying figures across statements and notes.
Checking cross-references and repeated totals.
Rolling forward prior-year reporting documents.
today.time_sinks: Late adjustments, incomplete disclosure information and repeated review cycles across inconsistent document versions.

lenses.faster: Populate statements and standard notes from a controlled mapping and run consistency checks automatically. Draft narrative disclosures from approved facts.
lenses.autonomous: Each approved trial balance version regenerates a draft package and highlights changed figures, broken checks and missing disclosure inputs.
lenses.ambitious: Maintain quarterly readiness for annual reporting so missing schedules, accounting questions and disclosure evidence surface earlier.
lenses.joy: Remove document roll-forwards and cross-casting. Keep accounting judgement, explanation and resolution of difficult review points.
lenses.options: Show the effects of alternative supportable accounting estimates for review, with assumptions and impacts separated from the approved accounts.
lenses.altitude: Own the reporting model, disclosure completeness and evidence chain from ledger to annual accounts.
reach: Controller: statutory reporting preparation and review tracking
FP&A Analyst: reconciled historical financial inputs for planning

tasks.human_edge: Judge estimates, going concern, materiality and disclosure adequacy, and challenge whether the statements fairly represent the business.
tasks.pattern_why: Deterministic software should populate statements and verify consistency; an llm_step can draft notes. Accounting judgements and formal approval require people.

in_practice.trigger: An approved trial balance version is released for financial statement preparation.
steps: Freeze the ledger version and validate mappings to the applicable Dutch reporting framework.
Generate statements, comparatives and supporting schedules with deterministic checks.
Populate a disclosure checklist and draft notes only from approved evidence.
Highlight missing information, changed estimates and unresolved accounting questions.
Route the complete package through accounting review, directors' approval and the applicable audit and filing process.
in_practice.human_gate: The accountant and Controller review accounting treatment and disclosures. Directors retain their statutory responsibilities, and any external audit opinion remains with the external auditor.
systems: AFAS Profit read-only export or approved connector
Controlled statement generation and validation software
data_needed: Approved trial balance, account mappings and comparatives
Balance sheet reconciliations and supporting schedules
Applicable reporting framework, entity scope and disclosure requirements
Approved estimates, commitments and subsequent-event information
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted annual reporting file linking ledger versions, statement cells, disclosure evidence, validation results and approvals.

evidence.claim: Financial statement population, cross-casting and comparative checks can be automated from controlled mappings and structured inputs.
Dutch annual reporting requirements depend on the applicable framework, entity structure and size regime.
The proposed workflow could save 50% of accountant effort and complete preparation 1.5 times faster; these are untested estimates.

risks: A correct mapping can still omit an entity, commitment or required disclosure.
Prior-year notes can carry forward outdated assumptions and facts.
Late journals can leave different statements based on different ledger versions.
Preparation support does not replace statutory approval or external audit, where required.
research_questions: Which reporting framework, group structure and size regime apply to Noordhaven?
Which reporting steps are already performed by external accountants or existing software?
Can every material statement figure and disclosure be traced to approved evidence?
How much elapsed time comes from preparation versus late inputs, audit queries and formal approvals?

tasks.short: Check transaction records and speak with colleagues to confirm how financial rules work in practice.

today.trigger: A compliance review, unusual transaction, audit request or concern about how a process operates.
steps: Define the review scope and applicable financial, legal or contractual requirements.
Select records and trace transactions through the documented process.
Prepare questions and speak with relevant workers or process owners.
Compare explanations with records and investigate contradictions.
Document conclusions and escalate or agree corrective action.
drudgery: Searching for records before interviews.
Preparing repetitive question lists.
Turning notes into evidence-linked review records.
today.time_sinks: Finding the right people across shifts and sites, then following up on gaps between explanations and recorded transactions.

lenses.faster: Assemble a transaction timeline and evidence pack before each conversation. Draft questions and organise the accountant's notes afterwards.
lenses.autonomous: Defined transaction checks can surface exceptions and prepare a review pack. The accountant chooses whom to speak with and conducts the conversation.
lenses.ambitious: Review more site and agency processes using consistent sampling and follow-through, while preserving a fair opportunity for people to explain exceptions.
lenses.joy: Remove record hunting and repetitive write-ups. Keep the conversations and detective work that reveal how the process really operates.
lenses.options: Offer several possible explanations and questions to test them, including evidence that could disprove the initial concern.
lenses.altitude: Design a fair, repeatable review approach and improve processes based on recurring causes.
reach: Bookkeeper: agency invoice exception investigation
Payroll Specialist: financial tracing of approved payroll postings
Controller: transaction compliance review preparation

tasks.human_edge: Build trust, ask sensitive questions fairly, recognise context and distinguish a process failure from an unsupported allegation against an individual.
tasks.pattern_why: Evidence gathering and draft notes can be assisted, but interviews, credibility assessment and conclusions remain led by the accountant.

in_practice.trigger: The accountant opens an authorised review with a defined purpose and scope.
steps: Collect only relevant records and apply a documented sampling method.
Build an evidence-linked transaction timeline and draft neutral questions.
Have the accountant conduct interviews and record proportionate notes.
Compare explanations against records and identify corroboration or contradictions.
Draft the review record for factual checking, accountant approval and appropriate escalation.
in_practice.human_gate: The accountant controls interviews and approves conclusions. HR, payroll or legal specialists validate employment-related interpretations; the workflow makes no automated personnel decisions.
data_needed: Review purpose, scope and applicable requirements
Relevant transaction records and approval history
Current policies, contracts and relevant CAO clauses
Proportionate interview notes and corroborating evidence
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted review file with access history, sampling rationale, evidence references, factual corrections, conclusions and retention dates.

evidence.claim: Models can help organise supplied records, prepare questions and draft notes, while interviews and conclusions require human judgement.
AVG purpose limitation and data minimisation apply to worker records used in compliance reviews.
The proposed workflow could save 30% of accountant effort and complete reviews 1.2 times faster; these are untested estimates.

risks: Exception rankings can bias interviews towards an allegation before facts are established.
CAO interpretation may require HR or legal expertise rather than accounting judgement.
Interview recordings or transcripts can collect unnecessary personal or sensitive information; use proportionate notes by default.
If expanded into worker monitoring or employment decisions, assess OR rights, AVG obligations and EU AI Act applicability before changing the purpose.
research_questions: Which reviews require worker interviews, and which can be resolved through transaction records alone?
How much preparation time could be removed without reducing interview quality or fairness?
Who approves review scope, access, retention and any employment-related escalation?
Can a pilot produce accurate, neutral evidence packs without irrelevant personal information?

role.altitude: Become the owner of reliable financial evidence and exception resolution: design reconciliations, maintain reporting rules and make sure significant judgements reach the right reviewer.
reach: Controller: recurring management reporting, balance sheet substantiation and financial control monitoring
FP&A Analyst: reconciled actuals, initial variance explanations and tax sensitivities for investment scenarios
Bookkeeper: recurring reconciliation checks and investigation of agency invoice exceptions
Payroll Specialist and HRIS Analyst: finance-side checks on payroll interfaces and approved postings
role.ceiling_note: The eight tasks total 415 hours per FTE annually, about 26% of the supplied role baseline. The proposed effort reductions imply roughly 417 hours of annual capacity across both accountants, worth about EUR 29,000 at EUR 70/hour, before overlap, implementation, maintenance and additional review. These are hypotheses, not cash savings or a staffing reduction. Current workflows are inferred; effort savings concern accountant hours, while speedups estimate elapsed task completion including normal handoffs. Tax advice, accounting judgement, interviews, director approval and external audit constrain further autonomy. Nightly data refresh and late operational inputs also limit improvements in days to close.
skills_to_grow: Designing and testing deterministic reconciliations and accounting rules
Understanding AFAS exports, account mappings and Power BI data lineage
Reviewing generated text against source evidence
Maintaining tax and reporting rule versions with specialist support
Designing access controls, approvals and auditable exception workflows
Investigating root causes and discussing financial findings with site managers
Measuring preparation time, review rework, close delays and audit adjustments
role.ambitious_version: Run a continuously substantiated ledger across Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo, with recurring reconciliations checked during the month and unresolved items assigned before close. Give the Controller and FP&A team timely, traceable actuals and explanations so the forecast rests on dependable numbers. Judge success by fewer close days and audit adjustments, alongside better forecast accuracy; agree responsibilities with adjacent roles and preserve independent preparation, approval and payment controls.
